name: \(\phi_B = B A \cos \theta\)
content: Magnetic flux when the magnetic field is at an angle \(\theta\) to the surface normal

name: \(\phi_B = B A\)
content: Magnetic flux when the field is perpendicular to the surface area (\(\theta = 0^\circ\))

name: \(\phi_B = 0\)
content: Magnetic flux when the field is parallel to the surface area (\(\theta = 90^\circ\))

name: \(E = -\frac{d\phi_B}{dt}\)
content: Faraday's Law of induction for a single turn wire loop

name: \(E = -N \frac{d\phi_B}{dt}\)
content: Faraday's Law of induction for a wire loop with \(N\) identical turns

name: \(P = VI\)
content: Electrical power formula in terms of voltage and current

name: \(B = \mu H\)
content: Relationship between magnetic flux density and magnetic field strength

name: \(E = N B A \omega \sin \omega t\)
content: Induced emf generated in an AC generator

name: \(\frac{V_s}{V_p} = \frac{E_s}{E_p} = \frac{N_s}{N_p} = \frac{I_p}{I_s}\)
content: Transformer relationship between voltage, emf, turns ratio, and current
